source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori possono essere a comando meccanico od elettronico

records.localized_text: Diesel injectors may be mechanically or electronically controlled.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, gli iniettori ricevono il gasolio in pressione dalla pompa di iniezione

records.localized_text: Diesel injectors receive pressurized fuel from the injection pump.

source.text_it: Nel sistema di iniezione "Common-rail", gli iniettori sono a comando elettronico

records.localized_text: Common-rail injectors are electronically controlled.

source.text_it: Il gasolio iniettato nei cilindri di un motore Diesel deve essere finemente polverizzato

records.localized_text: Diesel injected into engine cylinders must be finely atomized.

source.text_it: Gli iniettori di un motore Diesel hanno una pressione di iniezione che aumenta con l'aumentare della velocità del veicolo

records.localized_text: Diesel injector pressure increases as vehicle speed increases.

source.text_it: Il motore Diesel è in genere munito di una candeletta di preriscaldamento posta vicino alla presa d’aria

records.localized_text: A diesel engine generally has one glow plug near the air intake.

source.text_it: Se gli iniettori di un motore Diesel "gocciolano", devono essere puliti con acqua e ammoniaca

records.localized_text: Dripping diesel injectors must be cleaned with water and ammonia.

source.text_it: Gli iniettori ricevono il combustibile da una pompa a bassa pressione

records.localized_text: Injectors receive fuel from a low-pressure pump.

source.text_it: Se gli iniettori di un motore gocciolano vanno avvitati meglio nelle loro sedi

records.localized_text: Dripping engine injectors must be screwed more tightly into their housings.

source.text_it: Un motore Diesel è munito di almeno una candela per cilindro

records.localized_text: A diesel engine has at least one spark plug per cylinder.

source.text_it: Il motore Diesel funziona bene solo con poca aria aspirata dai cilindri

records.localized_text: A diesel engine runs well only when its cylinders draw in little air.

source.text_it: I motori Diesel di ultima generazione hanno l’accensione delle candele controllata elettronicamente

records.localized_text: Latest-generation diesel engines have electronically controlled spark plug ignition.

source.text_it: Nei motori Diesel più potenti, il gasolio viene iniettato a bassa pressione

records.localized_text: More powerful diesel engines inject diesel at low pressure.

source.text_it: I motori Diesel per autoveicoli lavorano normalmente ad alto numero di giri (4000-5000 giri/min)

records.localized_text: Motor vehicle diesel engines normally operate at high rpm, 4,000–5,000 rpm.

source.text_it: Il controllo elettronico dell’iniezione di combustibile è possibile solo nei motori a scoppio

records.localized_text: Electronic fuel injection control is possible only in spark-ignition engines.

source.text_it: L'iniezione gestita dall'impianto Common-rail fornisce una elevatissima pressione del gasolio, anche a bassi giri del motore

records.localized_text: Common-rail injection provides extremely high diesel pressure even at low engine rpm.

source.text_it: L'iniezione gestita dall'impianto Common-rail comporta un'elevatissima pressione del gasolio all'interno di un condotto comune (Rail)

records.localized_text: Common-rail injection produces extremely high diesel pressure in a common rail.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, l'iniezione gestita dall'impianto Common-rail permette una riduzione dei consumi e delle emissioni nocive

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, common-rail injection reduces consumption and harmful emissions.

source.text_it: Il Common-rail è un impianto di iniezione del gasolio di tipo puramente meccanico

records.localized_text: Common rail is a purely mechanical diesel injection system.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, l'alimentazione gestita dall'impianto Common-rail determina un'iniezione di gasolio a bassa pressione

records.localized_text: In a diesel engine, common-rail fuel supply results in low-pressure diesel injection.

source.text_it: L'iniezione gestita dall'impianto Common-rail penalizza la coppia motrice ai bassi regimi di giri

records.localized_text: Common-rail injection reduces engine torque at low rpm.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, il sistema di iniezione Common-rail è dotato di due circuiti del combustibile: uno a bassa ed uno ad alta pressione

records.localized_text: A diesel common-rail injection system has two fuel circuits, one low-pressure and one high-pressure.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, il sistema di iniezione Common-rail è dotato di una pompa che invia il gasolio ad elevatissima pressione agli elettroiniettori

records.localized_text: A diesel common-rail injection system has a pump that sends diesel to electronic injectors at extremely high pressure.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, il sistema di iniezione Common-rail ha un condotto comune (Common-rail o flauto) che contiene il combustibile inviato dalla pompa ad alta pressione

records.localized_text: A diesel common-rail injection system has a common rail containing fuel supplied by the high-pressure pump.

source.text_it: In un motore Diesel, il sistema di iniezione Common-rail è dotato di una centralina che elabora i dati dei sensori per gestire al meglio gli elettroiniettori

records.localized_text: A diesel common-rail injection system has a control unit that processes sensor data to manage electronic injectors optimally.

rows.text: Depending on the system, the injector can open mechanically under fuel pressure or be controlled electronically.
evidence: https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/parts/diesel_parts_1/pdf_30/en_5/repairs_on_diesel_systems_bosch.pdf — nozzle-and-holder assemblies include spring and injection nozzle
https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity
https://www.energy.gov/sites/default/files/2026-04/DOE-HDBK-1018-93_VOL1.pdf — Diesel Engine Fundamentals, fuel injectors: fuel pressure lifts injector valve from its seat

rows.text: In systems with a separate injection pump, the pump raises the diesel fuel to high pressure and sends it to the injectors, which introduce it into the cylinders.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

rows.text: In common rail, an electronic control unit controls the injectors, regulating injection timing and quantity.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

rows.text: Atomizing the fuel into fine droplets helps it vaporize and mix with the hot air, which is necessary for combustion.
evidence: https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/how-to-check-diesel-injector-spray-pattern — fine spray and workshop injector testing
https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — diesel draws and compresses air; injected fuel ignites in hot air without spark

rows.text: Injection pressure does not necessarily rise with vehicle speed: in common rail, pressure generation is separate from injection and the system controls the pressure.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure and supply pumps, rail, ECU, electronically controlled injectors; pressure availability independent of speed and load

rows.text: The glow plug is fitted in the cylinder head and projects into the combustion chamber or prechamber, where it helps with cold starting.
evidence: https://www.ngkntk.com/fileadmin/uk/media_library/ngk_glow_plugs_20_q_a.pdf — questions 1 and 2: glow plug in cylinder head and combustion or precombustion chamber; cold starting

rows.text: Dripping calls for a specialist workshop to diagnose the injector and check its sealing; water and ammonia are not the prescribed remedy.
evidence: https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/how-to-check-diesel-injector-spray-pattern — fine spray and workshop injector testing

https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/gasoline-fuel-systems/fuel-injection-system/petrol-fuel-injection/best-practice-advice-for-servicing-common-rail-injectors — diagnosis and repair procedures, leakage and nozzle issues

rows.text: In a conventional or common-rail injection system, fuel reaches the injector at high pressure; a low-pressure supply pump may instead feed the high-pressure pump.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure and supply pumps, rail, ECU, electronically controlled injectors; pressure availability independent of speed and load

rows.text: Dripping from the nozzle concerns the injector's sealing and needs diagnosis; tightening the injector in its seat will not repair an internal fault.
evidence: https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/gasoline-fuel-systems/fuel-injection-system/petrol-fuel-injection/best-practice-advice-for-servicing-common-rail-injectors — diagnosis and repair procedures, leakage and nozzle issues

https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/how-to-check-diesel-injector-spray-pattern — fine spray and workshop injector testing

https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/services/downloads/parts_14/diesel_system_components/diesel_system_components_brochure_en_reworked_92903.pdf — injection nozzles seal fuel system from combustion chamber

rows.text: A diesel engine ignites fuel using the heat of compressed air, without spark plugs. It may have glow plugs, which have a different function.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — diesel draws and compresses air; injected fuel ignites in hot air without spark
https://www.ngkntk.com/fileadmin/uk/media_library/ngk_glow_plugs_20_q_a.pdf — questions 1 and 2: glow plug in cylinder head and combustion or precombustion chamber; cold starting

rows.text: A diesel engine draws in and compresses air, then injects diesel fuel into the hot air. Combustion requires oxygen: the amount of fuel must be matched to the available air; the engine does not need to take in only a small amount of air.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — diesel draws and compresses air; injected fuel ignites in hot air without spark

https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — Air control: injected fuel quantity must be adapted to the air mass entering the cylinder for efficient combustion

rows.text: In a diesel engine, fuel ignites from the heat of compression, not from a spark produced by spark plugs. Electronics can instead control injection.
evidence: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/vehicles/articles/internal-combustion-engine-basics — diesel draws and compresses air; injected fuel ignites in hot air without spark
https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

rows.text: Diesel injection requires high pressure to introduce and atomize the fuel; it does not become low-pressure in more powerful engines.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

https://www.delphiautoparts.com/en-gb/products-and-technologies/diesel-fuel-systems/fuel-injection/diesel-fuel-injection/how-to-check-diesel-injector-spray-pattern — fine spray and workshop injector testing

rows.text: Engine speed varies with the engine and its use: the working range of a typical heavy-vehicle diesel is much lower than 4,000–5,000 rpm. For passenger-car diesels those figures can instead indicate rated maximum speed, rather than normal driving speed.
evidence: https://www.infrastructure.gov.au/sites/default/files/migrated/roads/safety/publications/1990/pdf/Edu_book_Truck.pdf — Figure 2.7, typical heavy-vehicle diesel: working range 1100–2000 rpm and normal maximum operating speed 2000 rpm

https://nitsri.ac.in/Department/Mechanical%20Engineering/Topic_-__Examples_Of_Engines_As_Per_Engine_Design_And_Operating_Parameters.pdf — Table 2, typical diesel passenger-car rated maximum speed 4000–5000 rpm; distinguishes rated maximum from normal running

rows.text: A diesel engine can also have electronically controlled injection: in common rail, the control unit manages the injectors.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

rows.text: In common rail, pressure generation is separate from injection: the rail keeps high-pressure fuel available even at low engine speeds.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure and supply pumps, rail, ECU, electronically controlled injectors; pressure availability independent of speed and load
https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

https://www.boschaftermarket.com/xrm/media/images/services/downloads/parts_14/diesel_system_components/diesel_system_components_brochure_en_reworked_92903.pdf — p. 3, CR pump: required pressure is available even at low engine speeds

rows.text: The high-pressure pump fills the rail, which stores pressurized diesel fuel and distributes it to the injectors.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

rows.text: Flexible control of injection timing and quantity allows more controlled combustion and can reduce consumption and emissions compared with less flexible systems.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

rows.text: Common rail is not purely mechanical: an electronic control unit controls the injectors and injection conditions.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

rows.text: In common rail, the pump pressurizes the fuel and the rail keeps it at high pressure for the injectors, not low pressure.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

rows.text: Common rail can maintain high injection pressure even at low engine speeds; this can improve torque at those speeds compared with systems whose pressure depends on engine speed. It does not necessarily reduce it.
evidence: https://publications.lib.chalmers.se/records/fulltext/225450/225450.pdf — section 2.1.4, common-rail pressure is independent of engine operating conditions; high pressure at low speed improves low-speed torque compared with other systems
https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — injection pressure available independently of engine speed and load

rows.text: The low-pressure circuit feeds the high-pressure pump, which supplies the rail and injectors in the high-pressure circuit.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-piezo/ — high-pressure and supply pumps, rail, ECU, electronically controlled injectors; pressure availability independent of speed and load
https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

rows.text: The pump generates high pressure and feeds the rail, from which diesel fuel reaches the electronically controlled injectors.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

rows.text: The rail is a common accumulator: it receives diesel fuel from the high-pressure pump and distributes it to the injectors.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity

rows.text: The control unit uses sensor information to calculate and control injection timing and quantity for each cylinder.
evidence: https://www.bosch-mobility.com/en/solutions/powertrain/diesel/common-rail-system-solenoid/ — high-pressure pump, rail, electronic control and injection timing and quantity
